title: Abraham Lincoln
location: Lincoln Memorial, 2 Lincoln Memorial Cir NW
description: Monumental seated sculpture of the 16th U.S. President gazing east toward the Reflecting Pool and Washington Monument.

title: Stone of Hope (Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.)
description: Carved likeness of civil rights leader Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. emerging from the 'Stone of Hope' beyond the 'Mountain of Despair.'

title: Thomas Jefferson
location: Thomas Jefferson Memorial, 16 E Basin Dr SW
description: Standing bronze figure of the 3rd U.S. President holding the Declaration of Independence inside the neoclassical rotunda.

title: Statue of Freedom
description: Classical female allegorical figure representing Freedom, wearing a crested helmet and crowning the dome of the U.S. Capitol.

title: Albert Einstein Memorial
location: National Academy of Sciences, 2101 Constitution Ave NW
description: Seated bronze sculpture of physicist Albert Einstein holding papers inscribed with three of his major scientific equations, overlooking a celestial star map.
